title: Physicochemical properties of tire-derived para-phenylenediamine quinones - A comparison of experimental and computational approaches
content:
Environ. Sci.: Processes Impacts, 2025, Accepted Manuscript
DOI: 10.1039/D5EM00153F, Paper
Simon Maguire, Misha Zvekic, Angelina Jaeger, Joseph Monaghan, Erik T. Krogh, Heather Wiebe
Para-phenylenediamine (PPD) compounds are added to tire rubber at percent levels to sacrificially react with oxidants for prolonged service life. Recently, the PPD transformation product N-(1,3-dimethylbutyl)-N’-phenyl-p-phenylenediamine quinone (6PPDQ) has been...
